clauses.requirement: For front end-outline marker lamps (AM) only (applicable to the rear lamp only if such a lamp is fitted), the standard light distribution measurement may, at the applicant's request, be considered from the VV line to the outboard side only (UN R148 para 5.1.4).
For front position lamps (A, MA) and front end-outline marker lamps (AM), no additional specific requirements apply (UN R148 para 5.1.5).
For front position lamps (A, MA) and front end-outline marker lamps (AM), failure provisions shall comply with paragraph 4.6 of UN R148 (para 5.1.6).
The colour of light emitted by front position lamps (A, MA) and front end-outline marker lamps (AM) shall be white; the lamp identified by symbol MA may be amber (UN R148 para 5.1.7).
Rear position lamps (R1, R2, MR) and rear end-outline marker lamps (RM1, RM2) shall comply with the specific technical requirements of UN R148 paragraph 5.2 and its sub-paragraphs.

The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of the rear position lamp (R1, R2, MR) or rear end-outline marker lamp (RM1, RM2) shall meet the requirements of Table 4; however, a luminous intensity of 6.0∙10^1 cd shall be permitted for rear position lamps reciprocally incorporated with stop lamps below a plane forming an angle of 5° downward from the horizontal plane (UN R148 para 5.2.1).

Rear position and rear end-outline marker lamps shall meet Table 4 luminous intensities: categories R1, MR or RM1: minimum 4.0∙10^0 cd, maximum 1.7∙10^1 cd as single lamp (steady), 8.5∙10^0 cd maximum for a lamp marked "D" (para 3.3.2.5.2), standard light distribution Figure A3-I, angles of geometric visibility Table A2-1, minimum 5∙10^-2 cd; categories R2 or RM2: minimum 4.0∙10^0 cd, maximum 4.2∙10^1 cd (variable), 2.1∙10^1 cd for lamp marked "D", Figure A3-I, Table A2-1, minimum 5∙10^-2 cd (references to para 4.8.3.1 (a)-(d)).
The minimum luminous intensity of the rear position lamp or rear end-outline marker lamp within the angles of geometric visibility shall comply with Table 4 (UN R148 para 5.2.2).
